The Scottish Poetry Library text is reproduced by permission of Penguin from New and Collected Poems 1931 to 2001 (copyright 1988 onward) and reads, lines 1 to 4: A day so happy. / Fog lifted early, I worked in the garden. / Hummingbirds were stopping over honeysuckle flowers. / There was no thing on earth I wanted to possess. A Year of Being Here (Ecco 2003 edition) agrees and states the poem was translated by Miłosz himself. Poetry Chaikhana drops the comma after early and some blogs print a full stop there; the licensed text has the comma, so the card is right. Nine lines, one stanza, dated Berkeley 1971; lines 1 to 4 correct and the cut falls at a full stop. shipped.js: nothing shipped or near; Miłosz 0 of 3; not banned.
